offering_description.value: Timken designs and manufactures engineered bearings and industrial motion products for equipment manufacturers and industrial operators. It sells through direct sales teams and distributors and repairs bearings and drivetrain equipment through its service network.

primary_products.value: engineered bearings; gear drives; automatic lubrication systems; linear motion systems; power transmission belts, chains and couplings

primary_services.value: bearing repair and remanufacturing; gearbox rebuilds; electric motor and generator repair; drivetrain field service

customer_segment.value: B2B: Equipment manufacturers, industrial plant operators, fleet operators and maintenance organizations

end_markets.value: industrial machinery; agriculture and construction equipment; renewable and conventional energy; rail and aerospace; metals and mining

revenue_model.value: product sales: Bearings and motion components for new equipment and aftermarket replacement; service fees: Equipment repair, remanufacturing and on-site maintenance

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: Turns steel and purchased parts into bearings and motion components for equipment manufacturers and maintenance buyers; OEM / manufacturer: Builds gear drives and lubrication systems from components for equipment manufacturers and industrial operators; service provider: Takes in worn bearings and drivetrain equipment for repair on behalf of industrial operators
value_chain_position.category: component supplier; OEM / manufacturer; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Engineered bearings, power transmission, lubrication, linear motion and industrial equipment repair

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving equipment manufacturers and industrial accounts; distributors / dealers: Authorized industrial distributors supplying replacement bearings and power transmission products; own locations: Service centers for bearing and industrial drivetrain repairs
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Manufacturing and repair facilities are subject to workplace safety and environmental rules, including OSHA and EPA requirements in the U.S.
